text:
58세 여성 환자, severe hemolytic uremic syndrome (HUS)로 입원함.  
BP 98/65 mmHg, HR 110 bpm, RR 24 bpm, BT 37.8°C, SpO2 92%.  
Severe fatigue 호소함.  
Methylprednisolone 500 mg IV q12h 적용함.  
Nasal cannula로 oxygen support 유지함.  
C-line 유지함.  
Negative fluid balance 확인됨.  
환자 drowsy 상태임.  
Hematology notify함.
